lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Hi, Ines. Ready for lesson eight? How did the forehand drills go this week?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Better, I think. The forehand feels more natural. The serve is still a mess though. Sorry again about missing the Tuesday lesson.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: No problem. Let's look at the serve. Your toss is drifting behind your head, which pulls the racquet off line. Try placing it a little in front, toward the net post.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Like this? Oh, that feels weird.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Weird is normal at first. Try a few more. There, that one was clean.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Okay, that one felt better.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: For next time, practice the serve toss twice before the next lesson, even without a racquet. Ten tosses each time.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Okay, I'll practice the serve toss twice before the next lesson.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: And I'll send you a fifteen minute drill video tonight, so you have something to follow.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: That would help, thanks.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I'll also book the court for Saturday tomorrow, once I check availability. Same time as usual?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Saturday works. Actually, I have a problem. Exams start soon and I'm really behind. I might skip next week, I'm not sure yet.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: That's okay. Do you want to keep the Saturday slot anyway?

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Maybe. I'll know better at the end of the week. I don't want to lose my progress though.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: You won't lose much in one week. The drills will help.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Right. I'm just stressed.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Understood. Let's keep it light. Ten minutes of tosses is plenty.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Okay. Thanks, Coach.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Recap: tosses twice before the next lesson from you, the video from me tonight, the court booked for Saturday, and you'll tell me about next week.

lines.speaker: client
lines.text: Yes, that's it.

commitments.text: practice the serve toss twice before the next lesson
commitments.quote: I'll practice the serve toss twice before the next lesson

commitments.text: send a fifteen minute drill video
commitments.quote: I'll send you a fifteen minute drill video tonight
I'll also book the court for Saturday tomorrow
